entries.reason: Tactics membership distinguishes process-local ECS generations from persisted SubjectRef identities.
entries.create: Tactics facade validates battle/side membership before assigning ECS handles; script sessions are allocated through RuntimeObjectRegistry.
entries.ownership: The ECS world owns entities, Tactics owns aggregate destruction responsibility, and scripts own only a generation/epoch proxy.
entries.destroy_order: Units release before sides and battles; either proxy-first or module-first destruction observes generations before release.
entries.restore: Snapshot restore resolves persisted SubjectRef identities against live target entities and never serializes ECS/runtime handles.
entries.stale: Every ECS use calls ecs::try_get and every script call resolves RuntimeHandleRef generation plus module owner epoch.

entries.reason: Tactics phase systems publish their access contract before operating on battle, side and unit roots.
entries.entity_scope: Battle, TacticalSide and TacticalUnit roots linked to the supplied module-owned battle
entries.view: generation-checked battle membership handles; systems perform no structural mutation during ECS view traversal
entries.read_set: identity, membership, turn resources and board cell/occupancy facts
entries.write_set: battle revision/turn/events/commands/objectives/reactions/board and tactical unit membership, position, resources and alive state
entries.structural_changes: none inside BattleSystem; Tactics facade creates candidates before checked registration and destroys rejected candidates
entries.events: battle, round, turn, action, reaction, defeat and objective transitions appended in deterministic sequence order
entries.services: injected SimulationStep and the shared ActionRuntime effect-executor contract; no required rendering provider
entries.phase: owner simulation thread after setup/command ingestion and before presentation

entries.reason: Battle snapshots and accepted command logs are deterministic inputs for save, replay and divergence diagnosis.
entries.schema: SnapshotEnvelope type tactics.battle with LogicalId schema tactics:battle.
entries.version: SchemaVersion 1; battle Revision and SimulationTick remain separate typed envelope fields.
entries.migration: There is no older released tactics schema; version 1 is exact and newer/unknown versions are rejected until an explicit migration is registered.
entries.unknown_fields: Envelope and tactics payload objects reject unknown or missing fields; arrays validate every owning record.
entries.restore_atomicity: Hash, identity, version, complete payload, links and invariants are validated in a local Candidate before one commit to battle/components.
